info.name: Neurotech Events API
info.description: Contract-first collection for the planned FastAPI backend. Import the companion environment and set base_url if the API runs elsewhere. Requests are grouped by product surface and domain. Authentication and ID-capture scripts are included for local development.

request.description: Implemented. Exact amount the server charges for a ticket, VAT included, plus availability.

item.name: Payments - Snippe (live)
item.description: Server-owned mobile-money payments. Prices come from the database; status is verified with Snippe.

request.description: Creates registration + payment, pushes a USSD prompt. Returns 201 with the payment.
Re-verifies open payments with Snippe on every read.

Admin - Transactions (super admin)
item.description: Requires Authorization: Bearer {{admin_api_token}} (ADMIN_API_TOKEN on the server).

request.description: Everything on the Snippe account, including transactions made outside this platform.
Signed by Snippe: X-Webhook-Signature = hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, '{timestamp}.{raw_body}')). Unsigned requests get 401.

item.name: Admin - Catalogue (super admin)
item.description: Publish the admin console's events and ticket types so live payments can price them. Requires ADMIN_API_TOKEN or a platform_admin login.

request.description: Implemented. Upserts by slug/code; tickets no longer listed are deactivated, never deleted.
